primarySource.title: Assessment of abundance, diversity and stomach content of freshwater fishes in Pampanga River along the municipality of Cabiao, Nueva Ecija, Philippines
primarySource.journal: International Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Studies
primarySource.accessReview: The complete five-page publisher-hosted PDF text was reviewed. No local PDF, figure, or article table image is retained in the repository.
primarySource.reuseReview: The PDF says © 2019 IJFAS. The journal's open-access page says articles are free to read, but no article-level Creative Commons or other reuse license was verified. Treat free access as distinct from redistribution permission; publication approval remains false.
primarySource.doiNote: No DOI was printed in the reviewed PDF or verified from the publisher record during this review.

studyDesign.gear: Dragnet with 2 cm mesh, with local fisherfolk supervising collection
studyDesign.identificationMethodAsReported: The authors say they used FishBase information to confirm collected fish identities; no voucher numbers or diagnostic data are reported in the reviewed text.
studyDesign.dietMethod: Stomachs were dissected; contents were separated into prey items, weighed, mounted on slides, and identified. The article presents qualitative stomach-content observations and aggregate indices.
studyDesign.sampleTotalScope: Total fish reported from the three study sites combined; not a catch-rate or whole-river abundance estimate.
sourceLimitations: The three sites are only labeled Site 1, Site 2, and Site 3; names, coordinates, and reach boundaries are not supplied.
The study is a single May 2019 collection using one stated gear type, not a complete or current Pampanga River checklist.
No voucher catalogue numbers or independent specimen identifications were located in the reviewed article.
A stomach observation is local and time-specific evidence; it is not a species-wide or year-round natural-diet profile.
Several diet statements in the discussion cite general literature; keep those distinct from the stomach contents observed in this sample.
